# `^BF` – MicroPDF417 Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md)


Print a MicroPDF417 barcode, a compact variant of PDF417 for area-efficient applications.

Reference parameters: **o, h, m**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 111](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
